summary: Join our 5-day Advanced PPP Structuring course to build bankable deals, master VfM analysis, and negotiate fair contracts. Hands-on Excel modeling included. Enr
lede: Public-private partnership (PPP) structuring training covers how senior professionals assess and shape long-term infrastructure and social sector projects. It develops practical skills in project feasibility and value for money assessment, risk allocation, financial modeling, and contract negotiation. Course exercises also address procurement, performance monitoring, stakeholder engagement, and emerging approaches such as AI-assisted screening and digital monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior professionals who lead, negotiate, or oversee complex PPP transactions in infrastructure and social sectors.
modules: PPP Models, Structures, and Project Identification
Feasibility Studies and Value for Money (VfM) Assessment
Risk Analysis, Allocation, and Mitigation Strategies
Financial Structuring and Modeling for Bankable Deals
PPP Procurement Strategies and Contract Negotiation
Contract Management, Performance Monitoring, and Dispute Resolution
Stakeholder Engagement, Renegotiation, and Emerging Trends
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Advanced understanding of project finance principles, working knowledge of financial modeling (Excel), and familiarity with public infrastructure policy. Participants must have 5+ years of experience in PPP, project finance, or infrastructure development. Coding Required: No. Level: Advanced. Tools: Participants must bring a laptop with Excel pre-installed; no commercial licenses required as we use open-source templates and provided datasets.
